test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The Warrens are __________ their house by the end of this month.
solution:
```html
The correct answer is '**going to shift**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase "**going to shift**" is used to indicate a planned future action.
 
• The sentence describes an action that will be completed by the end of this month, so the phrase "**going to shift**" is appropriate.
